rationale: All three lenses ran with parseable output and a spec was present. Acceptance lens: 8/8 criteria pass or n/a, no fail/partial. Standards: commit-format and code-quality pass (pre-commit hooks already enforced eslint/typecheck on both commits). Blind+edge-case raised 2 distinct concerns, both resolved without a blocking finding: (1) the 'non-string content on a type===\'create\' result' edge case (blind+edge, merged) was verified by code-path analysis to be pre-existing behavior unchanged by this fix (the old code's structuredPatch-first check already took that branch for any structuredPatch-bearing result regardless of content type) — classified defer, not introduced by this change. (2) The blind lens's 'overwrite-via-Write may not carry type===\'create\'' concern was independently checked against real transcript fixtures (grep for toolUseResult.originalFile across tests/**/*.jsonl and src/**/*.jsonl) and disproven: overwrite results carry type:'create' with a non-null originalFile and the new content, so the fix's type==='create' check already covers overwrites correctly — dismissed as a false positive. 2 additional blind-lens items (fixture tool_use_id reuse in the cumulative test; general comment/code-drift risk already called out in technical-analysis.md and accepted as this change's explicit minimal-fix design decision) were dismissed as below the emission floor / already-accepted tradeoffs, not current defects.
